label: first person
definition: pronouns and verbs used to refer to the speaker or writer of the language in which they occur

label: second person
definition: pronouns and verbs used to refer to the person addressed by the language in which they occur

label: third person
definition: pronouns and verbs that are used to refer to something other than the speaker or addressee of the language in which they occur

label: inclusive
definition: used of a word that refers to a group that includes the hearer

label: exclusive
definition: used of a word that refers to a group that excludes the hearer

label: singular
definition: the form of a word that is used to denote a singleton

label: dual
definition: a grammatical number category referring to two items or units as opposed to one item (singular) or more than two items (plural)

label: trial
definition: a grammatical number category referring to three items, where it contrasts with singular, dual and plural

label: plural
definition: the form of a word that is used to denote more than one

label: greater plural
definition: a grammatical number category referring to more than two (or three) items, in a language where plural contrasts with dual (or trial)

label: masculine
definition: male (of grammatical gender)

label: feminine
definition: female (of grammatical gender)

label: neuter
definition: neither male nor female (of grammatical gender)

label: person
definition: a human being

label: thing
definition: PWN's thing is "an artifact": find the right sense

label: entity
definition: that which is perceived or known or inferred to have its own distinct existence (living or nonliving)

label: place
definition: a point located with respect to surface features of some region

label: time
definition: an indefinite period (usually marked by specific attributes or activities)

label: manner
definition: how something is done or how it happens

label: reason
definition: a justification for something existing or happening

label: kind
definition: a category of things distinguished by some common characteristic or quality

label: duration
definition: the period of time during which something continues

label: quantity
definition: how much there is or how many there are of something that you can quantify

label: assertive existential
definition: of a pronoun or quantifier that asserts the existence of a referent without identifying it, as English some- (someone, something)

label: elective existential
definition: of a pronoun or quantifier that leaves the choice of referent free, as English any- (anyone, anything)

label: negative
definition: of a pronoun or quantifier that denies the existence of a referent, as English no- (nobody, nothing)

label: universal
definition: of a pronoun or quantifier that refers to every member of a set, as English every- (everyone, everything)

label: interrogative
definition: relating to the use of or having the nature of an interrogation

label: reflexive
definition: a personal pronoun compounded with -self to show the agent's action affects the agent

label: reciprocal
definition: a pronoun or pronominal phrase (as each other) that expresses a mutual action or relationship between the individuals indicated in the plural subject

label: other
definition: of a pronoun or quantifier that refers to a referent other than one already mentioned, as English other, another

label: formal
definition: (of spoken and written language) adhering to traditional standards of correctness and without casual, contracted, and colloquial forms

label: informal
definition: used of spoken and written language

label: polite
definition: showing regard for others in manners, speech, behavior, etc.

label: honorific
definition: conferring or showing honor or respect

label: non-honorific
definition: not conferring or showing honor or respect

label: proximal
definition: relating to or characteristic of a word referring to something at a proximal distance

label: medial
definition: relating to or characteristic of a word referring to something at a medium distance

label: distal
definition: relating to or characteristic of a word referring to something at a distal distance

label: remote
definition: relating to or characteristic of a word referring to something at a distal remote distance

label: men's speech
definition: speech used predominately by men

label: women's speech
definition: speech used predominately by women

label: archaic
definition: NTUMC links PWN's antediluvian ("so extremely old..."): find the sense for words no longer in use

label: specific known
definition: an indefinite pronoun function (Haspelmath 1997): the referent is specific and known to the speaker

label: specific unknown
definition: an indefinite pronoun function (Haspelmath 1997): the referent is specific but not known to the speaker

label: irrealis non-specific
definition: an indefinite pronoun function (Haspelmath 1997): the referent is non-specific, occurring only in some imagined mental space

label: question
definition: an indefinite pronoun function (Haspelmath 1997): the indefinite pronoun occurs in a question

label: conditional
definition: an indefinite pronoun function (Haspelmath 1997): the indefinite pronoun occurs in a subordinate conditional clause

label: indirect negation
definition: an indefinite pronoun function (Haspelmath 1997): the indefinite pronoun is in the scope of negation, but not of the same clause

label: direct negation
definition: an indefinite pronoun function (Haspelmath 1997): the indefinite pronoun is in the scope of negation within the same clause

label: comparative
definition: an indefinite pronoun function (Haspelmath 1997): the indefinite pronoun occurs in the standard of a comparative construction

label: free choice
definition: an indefinite pronoun function (Haspelmath 1997): the indefinite pronoun indicates free choice
